subject.title: ci: hourly sweeper re-fires dropped pull_request CI runs

question: Should this automation retain a manual dry-run entry point only through a separately trusted default-branch dispatch path, or ship schedule-only until such a path exists?
rationale: The required fix is not merely a test adjustment: maintainers must choose the acceptable operator workflow while preserving the protected-main boundary for app-token-backed automation.

options.title: Ship schedule-only first
options.body: Remove workflow_dispatch and retain the hourly schedule, which runs the default-branch workflow and avoids branch-selected privileged execution.

options.title: Add a trusted dispatch broker
options.body: Keep dry-run support only if a separately trusted default-branch workflow receives parameters and executes a fixed trusted revision before creating the app token.

recommendation.title: Ship schedule-only first
recommendation.body: Remove workflow_dispatch and retain the hourly schedule, which runs the default-branch workflow and avoids branch-selected privileged execution.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed work connects this contributor to both the dropped-CI diagnosis and the automation design.
